words.mean: 春节（中国最重要的传统节日）
四大发明（造纸、印刷、火药、指南针）
丝绸之路（古代贸易通道）
科举制度（古代选官考试）
瓷器（中国英文名 China 由此而来）
二十四节气（农耕时间体系）

sections.name: 第一编 · 发展变化类句型

items.s: With the development of ..., ... has/have witnessed great changes.
items.c: 随着……的发展，……见证了巨大变化。例：With the development of economy, China has witnessed great changes in tourism.

items.s: More and more people begin to realize the importance of...
items.c: 越来越多的人开始意识到……的重要性。例：More and more people begin to realize the importance of protecting traditional culture.

items.s: ... is becoming increasingly popular in China.
items.c: ……在中国变得越来越流行。例：Tai Chi is becoming increasingly popular among young people.

items.s: In recent years, ... has developed rapidly.
items.c: 近年来，……发展迅速。例：In recent years, high-speed railways have developed rapidly in China.

sections.name: 第二编 · 起源历史类句型

items.s: ..., which originated in ..., has a history of more than ... years.
items.c: ……起源于……，已有……多年的历史。例：Beijing Opera, which originated in the Qing Dynasty, has a history of more than 200 years.

items.s: It is said that ... dates back to ...
items.c: 据说……可以追溯到……。例：It is said that the custom dates back to the Tang Dynasty.

items.s: ... was first invented in ancient China.
items.c: ……最早发明于古代中国。例：Papermaking was first invented in ancient China.

items.s: According to the legend / historical records, ...
items.c: 据传说/史料记载，……。例：According to historical records, the Silk Road started from Chang'an.

sections.name: 第三编 · 评价地位类句型

items.s: ... is regarded / honored as one of the most ... in the world.
items.c: ……被誉为世界上最……之一。例：The Great Wall is regarded as one of the greatest wonders in the world.

items.s: ... plays an increasingly important role in ...
items.c: ……在……中扮演着越来越重要的角色。例：Traditional festivals play an important role in Chinese culture.

items.s: ... is famous / well-known for its ...
items.c: ……以……而闻名。例：Jingdezhen is famous for its high-quality porcelain.

items.s: It is universally acknowledged that ...
items.c: 大家公认……。例：It is universally acknowledged that Confucianism has influenced East Asia for centuries.

sections.name: 第四编 · 象征意义类句型

items.s: ... is a symbol of ...
items.c: ……是……的象征。例：The dragon is a symbol of good luck in Chinese culture.

items.s: ..., which symbolizes ..., is often used on ...
items.c: ……象征……，常用于……。例：The Chinese knot, which symbolizes reunion, is often used on festivals.

items.s: ... represents the wisdom of the Chinese people.
items.c: ……代表了中国人民的智慧。例：The Four Great Inventions represent the wisdom of the Chinese people.

items.s: ... carries people's best wishes for ...
items.c: ……承载着人们对……的美好祝愿。例：Red envelopes carry people's best wishes for the new year.

sections.name: 第五编 · 万能收尾句型

items.s: Therefore, it is of great significance to ...
items.c: 因此，……具有重要意义。例：Therefore, it is of great significance to protect intangible cultural heritage.

items.s: Only in this way can we ...
items.c: 只有这样我们才能……（倒装加分句型）。例：Only in this way can we pass on traditional culture to future generations.

items.s: ... has attracted worldwide attention.
items.c: ……吸引了全世界的关注。例：China's achievements in poverty reduction have attracted worldwide attention.

items.s: It can be predicted that ... will ... in the future.
items.c: 可以预见，未来……将会……。例：It can be predicted that traditional culture will regain its popularity.
